newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 2.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Wednesday's Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - John Calley, who has served as president of United Artists for the past three years, is in final negotiations to take a top leadership position at Sony Pictures Entertainment of Sony Corp.

HOLLYWOOD - Negotiations for the sale of Castle Rock Entertainment of Turner Broadcasting System Inc appear to have stalled, with MCA Inc dropping out of the running and Sony Pictures Entertainment's interest on hold until Sony resolves management turmoil.

HOLLYWOOD - MCA Inc has made an estimated $50 million to $75 million offer to Gannett Co for Multimedia Entertainment. All American Communications Inc was one of a number of parties who also expressed interest in buying Multimedia Entertainment.
HOLLYWOOD - Rival studios Warner Bros Television of Time Warner Inc and MCA's Universal Television are partnering on a new mid-season drama for ABC.
HOLLYWOOD - Beacon Communications is leaving Sony Pictures Entertainment and is moving to MCA Inc.
